title: Cancellation on intersections of shrinking graph neighborhoods
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, h:X→Z a scheme map, c=(j,c0) an open-then-proper compactification of h, and H=(a,e,p) a proper/open/proper presentation of h [def-pur-etale-graph-interchange-data]. Let a':X→W be proper and v:W→H.U open with a' v=a, and put S=(a',v e,p). Use the literal first and second graph-neighborhood words O1_H,O2_H,O1_S,O2_S and graphMiddle_H:O1_H→O2_H, graphMiddle_S:O1_S→O2_S of [def-pur-etale-graph-neighborhood-words]. Let T:O2_H→O2_S be the inverse shrinking-neighborhood triangle and L:O1_H→O1_S be graphSide1_H inverse followed by graphSide1_S. Then graphMiddle_H followed by T equals L followed by graphMiddle_S, as derived natural transformations. No second-side Cartesian exchange is included in this equation.

proof.text: Apply the second-projection pasting to L2_H followed by the inverse neighborhood triangle T, obtaining K followed by L2_S. Reassociate. Apply the first-projection pasting to L1_H followed by K, obtaining graphFirstShrinkIso followed by L1_S. Reassociate once more and use the smaller middle-word factorization. This proves precisely the original natural-transformation equality.

lean.statement: theorem etaleGraphShrinkMiddlePasting (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {X Z W : Scheme.{u}} {h : X ⟶ Z} (c : Compactification h) (H : EtaleGraphPresentation h) (a' : X ⟶ W) (v : W ⟶ H.U) [IsProper a'] [IsOpenImmersion v] (fac : a' ≫ v = H.a) : (H.graphMiddle c A).hom ≫ (H.graphNeighborhoodTriangle c A a' v fac).hom = (H.graphFirstShrinkIso c A a' v fac).hom ≫ ((H.shrink a' v fac).graphMiddle c A).hom
